body:
AMEND, narrowly. The stage boundary is correct and current source still supports it, but the proposed file surface omits one accepted C1 deliverable and two phrases could overclaim authority.

Review basis: current main is 4be3bc3b84bff01ae4b267b12d53b2e8273751d0; a Scala-source search still finds none of SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, EvidenceSupport, NarrativeSourceAtlas, or MediaAtlas. No relevant production seam changed from the accepted 07d1aa94 audit. D2 V8 b3c7e1d04a281cf711c0acda390292b7d8040eac is not yet an ancestor of main, so this is design review only; the proposed exact-landed-authority gate remains necessary.

1. Restore the missing C1 boundary payload file. The accepted plan assigns typed boundary layers to C1, but the topology names no owner. Add a portable `core/boundary.scala` or explicitly place the same payloads in another C1 core file. It should distinguish shot-boundary existence/localization, lawful transition morphology and extent, coded-scene judgment, narrative-event boundary, visual-rhyme relation, and search coverage states. C1 defines only unlicensed payloads and construction/refusal laws. Media FeatureTarget cases, feature tracks, proposal/critic envelopes, ClaimMeta status licensing, resolver integration, and accepted claims remain D1. Do not force all boundaries into one generic enum.

2. Add or name the native timestamp envelope. `axis.scala` can own it, but the implementation topology must account for operation-provenance-sensitive timestamp classification, independently optional PTS/DTS, retained original fields on PTS below DTS refusal, and known-positive versus unknown packet duration. This is provider-free C1 data and logic; it imports no FFmpeg API. The realized FFmpeg adapter court remains E0. A test cannot prove the D2 V8 mutations unless this public construction boundary exists somewhere.

3. Keep B0-C, D0, and D1 artifacts out of C1 types.

- B0-C owns the normative two-acquisition-run specification and synthetic input/expected-output oracle. C1 may instantiate that oracle against generic ClockRepair types, but it must not add Sherlock, workbook-row, or source-specific TwoRun types.
- D0 owns the exact admitted row parser, source-specific row dispositions, application of the B0 rule, and realized repair/aggregate receipt.
- D1 owns NarrativeCompilerInput, StoryModel, AlignmentSource/SourceView, feature, claim/evidence, codec/schema, proposal/resolver, and view integration.

`SourceBundle` should be semantically neutral immutable source identity, not an object that asserts admission. Admission and mutable use authorization live in the separate build envelope. Merely constructing a bundle must not fabricate a rights licence.

4. Constrain two C1 payloads so core remains the dependency floor.

- `NarrativeSourceAtlas` in core may contain only core-owned source-unit identities, checked source support, and bundle/axis references. It cannot mention PropositionChart, acquire proposals, NarrativeCompilerInput, NarrativeCompilation, FeatureTarget, or story nodes. Those modules all depend on core, never the reverse.
- `EditionCorrespondence` may be represented in C1 as an evidential relation payload with partial and set-valued outcomes, but it must not expose an unlicensed coordinate cast. Its accepted claim wrapper and scientific consumption require D1 evidence/status integration. ClockRepair and TrackComposition remain checked operational mapping families.

5. Yes, additive text and transcript conformance is lawfully provable before codec/compiler integration, with a bounded claim. C1 can prove in memory that:

- SurfaceAtlas source checksum, units, UTF-16 spans, ordering, lookup, and exact text support survive projection into the new atlas and retraction to the legacy view;
- existing SurfaceAtlas and TranscriptAtlas suites pass unchanged;
- AudioSpan None, nonempty [1000,1500), and explicit empty [2000,2000) remain distinct and preserve half-open turnAtAudio behavior;
- no legacy timing constructs media EvidenceSupport while unbound;
- checked binding creates only a named local 1/1000 axis, and edition use still requires a separate mapping;
- packet-duration unknown cannot be represented by the legacy empty interval.

Call this an in-memory semantic retraction or observational round-trip, not byte compatibility or serialization round-trip. With codecs excluded, C1 cannot prove JSON bytes, schema migration, persisted backward compatibility, or compiler consumption. Those are D1 gates.

6. Minimal cross-platform placement: production ADTs and smart constructors stay in the existing pure `core` crossProject; implementation examples and mutation probes stay in core/src/test; reusable generators/laws stay in the existing cross-built `laws` module. No new module or dependency is warranted. Canonical fingerprints must use explicit sorted semantic fields and existing portable hashing, never platform `toString`, map iteration, filesystem paths, java.time, or a Circe codec smuggled in early.

With these amendments, ACCEPT the proposed additive C1 topology and exclusions. Without the boundary payload owner and the bounded meaning of round-trip, the topology would be smaller than the accepted C1 contract while claiming a proof it cannot yet make.
